# Call centre KPI dashboard

*Client industry: telecom | Completed: 2022-06-02 | Evidence id: data_analyst:case:p14*

## The problem
The client was a call centre manager with no live view of queues.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using an interactive Microsoft dashboard, hand-written analytical queries, ETL. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project cut average abandonment rate from 14% to 8%.
